comparison.objective: Install a carriage on a linear rail and push it through a detent to an end stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Align a close-fitting profile, start a linear insertion, maintain squareness, and overcome a spring plunger.
comparison.success_condition: Carriage seated on the rail, past the restored plunger, against the stop, with the rail not substantially displaced.
comparison.reason: This is precision profile insertion with detent engagement. It does not test loosening and relocking an adjustment mechanism or tuning from measured impact response.
